Here are three colors:

1. Red
2. Blue
3. Green
The capital of France is Paris.

Silver threads stitch the sky to the street,
Washing the world in a quiet retreat.

The sky appears blue because sunlight is scattered in all directions by the gases and particles in Earth's atmosphere, with blue light being scattered more than other colors because it travels in shorter, smaller waves. This phenomenon, known as Rayleigh scattering, causes our eyes to perceive the sky as predominantly blue during the day.

proposal_notes: Single knob change only; preserves parent image, entrypoint, model, --io-impl=zio, --max-context-len=128000, port 8000, greedy sampling, benchmark and accounting. No measured gain is claimed; this is a hypothesis for later build/measure. Sequential workload never admits >1 request, so batch-size=1 matches the actual concurrency; prior batch16-to1 controller-repaired run improved serial TTFT/FTGR within startup limit, but no official/general gain is inferred.
